events.name: Buffalo Sabres at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — U.S. Olympian Tage Thompson scored his 31st goal of the season and added an assist to help the Buffalo Sabres beat the New Jersey Devils 2-1 on Wednesday night in the NHL's return to action.
headlines.shortLinkText: U.S. Olympian Tage Thompson has goal and assist in Sabres' 2-1 win over Devils

headlines.description: — Defensemen Trevor van Riemsdyk and Rasmus Sandin ended long goal droughts and the Washington Capitals beat the Philadelphia Flyers 3-1 on Wednesday night, their fifth win in their last six games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sandin and van Riemsdyk score rare goals and Capitals beat Flyers 3-1

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored to give him his ninth 30-goal season and added two assists for 701 in his career and the Tampa Bay Lightning defeated the Toronto Maple Leafs 4-2 on Wednesday night for their sixth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kucherov hits 30 goals again as Lightning roll past Maple Leafs 4-2 for 6th straight win

headlines.description: — Wyatt Johnston scored his 30th and 31st goals of the season as the Dallas Stars beat the Seattle Kraken 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wyatt Johnston's two goals lead Stars past Kraken 4-1

headlines.description: — U.S. Olympian Brock Nelson scored his 30th goal of the season in Colorado's four-goal second period and the NHL-leading Avalanche beat the Utah Mammoth 4-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: NHL-leading Avalanche beat Mammoth 4-2 in return from Olympic break

headlines.description: — Cole Perfetti scored off a rebound at 1:37 of overtime to give the Winnipeg Jets a 3-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole Perfetti scores in overtime in the Jets' 3-2 victory over the Canucks

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Joel Quenneville became the second coach in NHL history to win 1,000 games with the Anaheim Ducks' 6-5 comeback victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joel Quenneville gets his 1,000th career win in Ducks' 6-5 comeback victory over Oilers
